name: stock-behaviour
description: Stage 0: what the stock firmware sends in each mode. Read-only: nothing is sent to the mixer. Keep away from BT and from power-on key combinations (they are tested separately).

steps.text: Do not touch the mixer (idle traffic and fader noise).
Press Shift, hold it for 2 s, release.
steps.ask: Which LEDs were lit while Shift was held (for example ◀ or ▶)?

steps.text: Hold Shift, press ◀ (10th bottom-row button), release both.
[after Shift+◀] Press and release M1 (strip 1) twice, about one second apart.
[after Shift+◀] Press M1, hold it for 2 s, release.
[after Shift+◀] Press and release S1 twice.
[after Shift+◀] Press and release R1 twice.
[after Shift+◀] Press and release SELECT (□) 1 twice.
[after Shift+◀] Press M8, S8, R8 and SELECT 8 once each, in that order.
[after Shift+◀] Move fader 1 slowly from the bottom to the top (about 3 s), then slowly back to the bottom.
[after Shift+◀] Move fader 1 quickly to the top and back to the bottom, twice.
[after Shift+◀] Put fader 1 roughly in the middle and let go of it.
[after Shift+◀] Do not touch anything (fader noise at rest).
[after Shift+◀] Turn encoder 1 slowly 10 clicks to the right (clockwise), counting the clicks.
[after Shift+◀] Turn encoder 1 slowly 10 clicks to the left.
[after Shift+◀] Turn encoder 1 quickly one full turn to the right, then one full turn to the left.
[after Shift+◀] Push encoder 1 twice.
[after Shift+◀] Without Shift, press each bottom-row button once, left to right: Play, Stop, Rec, Rew, FF, «, », ▲, ▼, ◀, ▶.
[after Shift+◀] Hold Shift, move fader 1 to the top and back to the bottom, release Shift.
[after Shift+◀] Hold Shift, turn encoder 1 five clicks to the right, release Shift.
[after Shift+◀] Hold Shift, press and release M1, release Shift.
steps.ask: Did any LED change? (Enter if nothing)

steps.text: Hold Shift, press ▶ (11th bottom-row button), release both.
[after Shift+▶] Press and release M1 (strip 1) twice, about one second apart.
[after Shift+▶] Press M1, hold it for 2 s, release.
[after Shift+▶] Press and release S1 twice.
[after Shift+▶] Press and release R1 twice.
[after Shift+▶] Press and release SELECT (□) 1 twice.
[after Shift+▶] Press M8, S8, R8 and SELECT 8 once each, in that order.
[after Shift+▶] Move fader 1 slowly from the bottom to the top (about 3 s), then slowly back to the bottom.
[after Shift+▶] Move fader 1 quickly to the top and back to the bottom, twice.
[after Shift+▶] Put fader 1 roughly in the middle and let go of it.
[after Shift+▶] Do not touch anything (fader noise at rest).
[after Shift+▶] Turn encoder 1 slowly 10 clicks to the right (clockwise), counting the clicks.
[after Shift+▶] Turn encoder 1 slowly 10 clicks to the left.
[after Shift+▶] Turn encoder 1 quickly one full turn to the right, then one full turn to the left.
[after Shift+▶] Push encoder 1 twice.
[after Shift+▶] Without Shift, press each bottom-row button once, left to right: Play, Stop, Rec, Rew, FF, «, », ▲, ▼, ◀, ▶.
[after Shift+▶] Hold Shift, move fader 1 to the top and back to the bottom, release Shift.
[after Shift+▶] Hold Shift, turn encoder 1 five clicks to the right, release Shift.
[after Shift+▶] Hold Shift, press and release M1, release Shift.
steps.ask: Did any LED change? (Enter if nothing)

steps.text: Switch back to the mode you normally use (Shift+◀ or Shift+▶).
Do not touch the mixer.
